item.title: Urgent Request for Street Cleansing and Sanitisation – Public Health Biohazard at Carlton Parade, Orpington, 15th September
item.description:
Location Description:On the public footpath and directly coating the public recycling bottle banks at Carlton Parade, Orpington, situated underneath the mature trees where feral parakeets roost.Detailed Description of the Problem:I am reporting a severe, heavy, and recurring accumulation of parakeet guano on the public highway and local amenities at Carlton Parade. Hundreds of parakeets roost in the trees overhead each evening, resulting in a substantial volume of bird droppings coating both the pedestrian footpath and the high-touch surfaces of the recycling bottle banks.This situation presents three immediate hazards to the community:Public Health Risk (Inhalation & Contact): The guano dries into an airborne dust that pedestrians and residents breathe in. This carries a documented risk of psittacosis (parrot fever) and fungal respiratory infections. Furthermore, the recycling banks are high-touch areas, creating an immediate cross-contamination risk for salmonella and E. coli.Slip and Fall Hazard: When wet from rain or fresh overnight roosting, the heavy layer of guano makes the pavement exceptionally slick, presenting a severe slipping hazard to pedestrians, particularly the elderly or those with limited mobility.Environmental Damage: The highly acidic nature of the waste is damaging the council's recycling infrastructure and the public pathway.Due to the volume and biological nature of the waste, this requires professional deep-cleaning, pressure-washing, and biohazard sanitisation rather than standard street sweeping. Please task the street cleansing team to wash and sanitise this specific area urgently, and consider a routine maintenance schedule given the seasonal roosting habits of the birds in this specific tree
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): High Street, Ramsden, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
